data.one_liner: Converts Cyrillic symbols to Translit and back.
data.what_it_does: Provides simple methods to convert Cyrillic text into transliterated text and back to Cyrillic. Supports both symmetrical and non-symmetrical algorithms.
use_when: You need to convert Cyrillic text into Latin characters for URLs or IDs.
You need to reverse transliterate text back into Cyrillic.
avoid_when: You need flawless, lossless reverse transliteration back to the original text without ambiguities.
You are looking for full general-purpose internationalization and translation tooling.
strengths: Simple and straightforward API for text conversion.
Supports both symmetrical and non-symmetrical transliteration algorithms.
weaknesses: Reverse transliteration into Cyrillic cannot always completely convert the text back to the original format.
Not documented for extensive locale-aware formatting beyond simple character mapping.
